def new_board():

def shuffle_board(board):
    """Reshuffle existing candies until the board is match-free but playable."""
    cells = [t for row in board for t in row]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------- matching

def _runs(line):
    """Yield index ranges of runs of 3+ identical, non-empty values."""
    i, n = 0, len(line)
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j < n and line[j] == line[i] and line[i]:
            j += 1
        if j - i >= 3:
            yield range(i, j)
        i = max(j, i + 1)


def find_matches(board):
    """Set of (r, c) cells belonging to any horizontal/vertical run of 3+."""
    matches = set()
    for r in range(ROWS):
        for run in _runs([board[r][c] for c in range(COLS)]):
            matches.update((r, c) for c in run)
    for c in range(COLS):
        for run in _runs([board[r][c] for r in range(ROWS)]):
            matches.update((r, c) for r in run)
    return matches


def any_move(board):
    """True if some adjacent swap would create a match."""
    for r in range(ROWS):
        for c in range(COLS):
            for dr, dc in ((0, 1), (1, 0)):

                if nr < ROWS and nc < COLS:
                    board[r][c], board[nr][nc] = board[nr][nc], board[r][c]
                    hit = bool(find_matches(board))
                    board[r][c], board[nr][nc] = board[nr][nc], board[r][c]
                    if hit:
                        return True
    return False

def apply_gravity(board):
    """Drop candies into gaps and refill the top with fresh random candies."""
    for c in range(COLS):
        column = [board[r][c] for r in range(ROWS) if board[r][c]]
        fresh = [random.choice(CANDY_TYPES) for _ in range(ROWS - len(column))]
        for r, candy in enumerate(fresh + column):
            board[r][c] = candy


def try_swap(board, r1, c1, r2, c2):
    """Swap two adjacent candies; revert and return False if it makes no match."""
    if not (0 <= r1 < ROWS and 0 <= c1 < COLS and 0 <= r2 < ROWS and 0 <= c2 < COLS):
        return False, "Coordinates out of range."
    if abs(r1 - r2) + abs(c1 - c2) != 1:
        return False, "The two candies must be orthogonally adjacent."
    board[r1][c1], board[r2][c2] = board[r2][c2], board[r1][c1]
    if not find_matches(board):
        board[r1][c1], board[r2][c2] = board[r2][c2], board[r1][c1]
        return False, "That swap does not create a match (no move used)."
    return True, ""

def render(board, score, moves, target):

            row += f"{COLORS[t]} {t} {RESET}" if (USE_COLOR and t) else f" {t or '.'} "
        lines.append(row)
    return "\n".join(lines)
